When sorting alphanumeric identifiers such as blocker IDs, avoid strict byte-order comparisons or direct localeCompare on potentially nullish values. Use a null-safe natural string comparator to ensure stable and correct sorting.

```suggestion
  })).sort((left, right) => (left.blocker_id ?? '').localeCompare(right.blocker_id ?? '', undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When sorting alphanumeric or potentially non-numeric identifiers (such as variants or question numbers), avoid arithmetic subtraction which can yield NaN and cause unstable sorting. Use a null-safe natural string comparison instead.
2. When sorting strings that can be null or undefined, use a null-safe natural string comparator to prevent calling localeCompare directly on nullish values.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

When sorting markdown readback tables by identifiers (such as Role or ID), use a null-safe natural string comparator to ensure stable sorting and prevent errors if any values are null or undefined.

```javascript
  const artifactLines = [...audit.source_artifacts]
    .sort((left, right) => (left.role ?? '').localeCompare(right.role ?? '', undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }))
    .map((artifact) => "| " + artifact.group + " | " + artifact.role + " | " + (artifact.exists ? "present" : "missing") + " | " + artifact.path + " |")
    .join("\n");
  const checkLines = [...validatorResult.checks]
    .sort((left, right) => (left.id ?? '').localeCompare(right.id ?? '', undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }))
    .map((item) => "| " + item.id + " | " + item.status + " | " + item.summary + " |")
    .join("\n");
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When sorting strings that can be null or undefined, use a null-safe natural string comparator to prevent calling localeCompare directly on nullish values.
2. When sorting alphanumeric or potentially non-numeric identifiers (such as variants or question numbers), avoid arithmetic subtraction which can yield NaN and cause unstable sorting. Use a null-safe natural string comparison instead.
</details>

Fixed in 2768740b0. Added a shared null-safe natural string comparator and switched grouped blocker sorting to compareByKey("blocker_id"), with artifact group sorting using the same comparator. Verified with targeted Jest, node --check, and the privacy gate --check.

Verified with targeted Jest and the privacy gate --check.

Fixed in 2768740b0. Readback artifact and validator tables now sort copied arrays by null-safe natural role/id keys, and the generated readback artifact was regenerated. Added coverage for the expected table order. Verified with targeted Jest and the privacy gate --check.
